name: weaver
description: Deterministic Architecture-as-Code pipeline: extracts architecture signals from a polyglot Java/Python/Node monorepo and generates FINOS CALM 1.2 JSON

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && mkdir -p dist/rules/control-requirements && cp src/rules/signal-catalogue.yml src/rules/node-type-mapping.yml src/rules/relationship-type-mapping.yml src/rules/control-requirement-catalogue.yml src/rules/persistence-detection-catalogue.yml src/rules/scope-limitations.yml src/rules/messaging-detection-catalogue.yml src/rules/http-client-detection-catalogue.yml src/rules/env-relationship-allowlist.yml src/rules/wiring-annotation-catalogue.yml dist/rules/ && cp src/rules/control-requirements/*.json dist/rules/control-requirements/ && cp src/scanner/engine-capability-matrix.yml dist/scanner/ && node scripts/generate-control-url-mapping.js && mkdir -p dist/modules/threat-signals dist/modules/resilience-lens && cp src/modules/threat-signals/fitness.json dist/modules/threat-signals/ && cp src/modules/resilience-lens/fitness.json dist/modules/resilience-lens/ && mkdir -p dist/rules/codeql-queries/di-resolution && cp src/rules/codeql-queries/di-resolution/di_resolution.ql src/rules/codeql-queries/di-resolution/qlpack.yml src/rules/codeql-queries/di-resolution/codeql-pack.lock.yml dist/rules/codeql-queries/di-resolution/ && mkdir -p dist/rules/codeql-queries/command-dispatch && cp src/rules/codeql-queries/command-dispatch/command_dispatch.ql src/rules/codeql-queries/command-dispatch/qlpack.yml src/rules/codeql-queries/command-dispatch/codeql-pack.lock.yml dist/rules/codeql-queries/command-dispatch/ && mkdir -p dist/rules/codeql-queries/jpa-entity-table && cp src/rules/codeql-queries/jpa-entity-table/jpa_entity_table.ql src/rules/codeql-queries/jpa-entity-table/qlpack.yml src/rules/codeql-queries/jpa-entity-table/codeql-pack.lock.yml dist/rules/codeql-queries/jpa-entity-table/
